note: No keyless live AIS feed for US waters could be verified from here: MarineTraffic's data endpoint returns a 403 bot wall from this network, AISHub/VesselFinder/Global Fishing Watch all require accounts, and the free public AIS APIs that exist (e.g. Finland's Digitraffic) cover other seas. AISStream.io's free tier IS the route: set AISSTREAM_API_KEY (free signup at aisstream.io) and this fetcher collects live Columbia River positions over their websocket.
